description: Execution-scope thresholds and concurrency limits read by /jenga and /do; every successful set also increments threshold_version.

keys.label: Threshold version
keys.description: Version counter for this file; jenga config increments it on every successful set, so it is never set directly.

keys.label: Inline max files
keys.description: Most files a task may touch and still run inline (no subagent, no worktree).

keys.label: Inline max lines
keys.description: Most total lines changed for a task to still run inline.

keys.label: Story max files
keys.description: Most files a task may touch to qualify for story-scope bundling (several tasks in one developer context).

keys.label: Bundle lock TTL (minutes)
keys.description: Minutes after which a story-bundle lock counts as stale and may be reclaimed.

keys.label: Max concurrent developers
keys.description: Most developer subagents (one slot per story bundle) one orchestrating session may run at once.

keys.label: Max concurrent testers
keys.description: Most in-session tester invocations one orchestrating session may run at once; on a full cap the developer falls back to the handoff queue.

keys.label: Slot TTL (minutes)
keys.description: Minutes after which a held developer or tester concurrency slot is treated as stale and reclaimed.

keys.label: Marker TTL (minutes)
keys.description: Minutes after which a pre-flight situation-marker frame counts as absent, so a session that died mid-phase cannot wedge later ones.
